milestones.claim: Phase 1: a non-blocking FROZEN_CLAIM_DRIFT advisory detects and reports frozen userSees drift (story-owned material via storyFilesHash OR the normalized claim-digest) and classifies a no-snapshot userSees as legacy-unbound.
milestones.doneMeans: frozen_claim_drift_check prints the structured advisory for a drifted story and a clean report for a clean story; the deterministic offline smoke (including the unrelated-change and whitespace-only false-positive guards) is green under validate; no gate verdict changes.
